entities.name: Query URO-D
observations: 347 aa protein with exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A1AXS4 uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase.
Contains the URO-D Pfam domain PF01208.24 across residues 5–344.
Predicted enzyme molecular mass is 38.8 kDa; curated homologs are cytosolic homodimers.

entities.name: Uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase
observations: EC 4.1.1.37; catalyzes decarboxylation of the four acetate groups of uroporphyrinogen-III to form coproporphyrinogen-III.
Curated reaction is uroporphyrinogen III + 4 H+ = coproporphyrinogen III + 4 CO2 (Rhea RHEA:19865).
Participates in the fourth and final step of the heme/protoporphyrin-IX biosynthetic route from 5-aminolevulinate.
Reviewed homologs are annotated as cytosolic homodimers and do not require a separately listed cofactor.

entities.name: URO-D decarboxylation
observations: Uroporphyrinogen III + 4 H+ → coproporphyrinogen III + 4 CO2.
The four acetate side chains are decarboxylated, yielding four methyl groups in the product.

entities.name: Heme biosynthesis
observations: Uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase performs step 4 of 4 in conversion from 5-aminolevulinate toward coproporphyrinogen III/protoporphyrin IX.
